Name: entry_pdb_id
Description: RCSB PDB ID. See https://mmcif.wwpdb.org/dictionaries/mmcif_pdbx_v50.dic/Items/_entry.id.html

Name: system_id
Description: ID of the system

Name: system_biounit_id
Description: Biounit ID

Name: interface_chain_1
Description: First canonical assembly-chain instance

Name: interface_chain_2
Description: Second canonical assembly-chain instance

Name: interface_chain_1_residue_numbers
Description: Source-mmCIF residue numbers at the interface on chain 1

Name: interface_chain_1_residue_indices
Description: Zero-based resolved-chain indices corresponding positionally to chain 1 residue numbers

Name: interface_chain_2_residue_numbers
Description: Source-mmCIF residue numbers at the interface on chain 2

Name: interface_chain_2_residue_indices
Description: Zero-based resolved-chain indices corresponding positionally to chain 2 residue numbers

Name: interface_num_contact_residue_pairs
Description: Number of residue pairs in contact across the protein interface

Name: prodigy_is_annotated
Description: Whether PRODIGY-cryst features and a biological/crystal label are available

Name: prodigy_label
Description: PRODIGY-cryst BIO or XTAL interface label

Name: prodigy_probability_bio
Description: PRODIGY-cryst probability that the interface is biological

Name: prodigy_link_density
Description: PRODIGY-cryst interface link-density feature

Name: prodigy_intermolecular_contacts
Description: PRODIGY-cryst count of intermolecular atomic contacts

Name: prodigy_charged_charged_contacts
Description: PRODIGY-cryst count of charged-charged contacts

Name: prodigy_charged_polar_contacts
Description: PRODIGY-cryst count of charged-polar contacts

Name: prodigy_charged_apolar_contacts
Description: PRODIGY-cryst count of charged-apolar contacts

Name: prodigy_polar_polar_contacts
Description: PRODIGY-cryst count of polar-polar contacts

Name: prodigy_apolar_polar_contacts
Description: PRODIGY-cryst count of apolar-polar contacts

Name: prodigy_apolar_apolar_contacts
Description: PRODIGY-cryst count of apolar-apolar contacts
